effects.text: A bank of wildflowers brightens the road, and the party carries the color with them for a while.
An old milestone leans from the verge, its weathered arrow pointing true enough to steady the journey.
Clear water bubbles from a roadside spring, cold enough to put strength back into tired legs.
A quiet hermit shares bitter trail tea and a practical warning about the road ahead.
Loose stones and bad footing turn the next stretch into a grinding, footsore slog.
A hungry traveler asks for enough coin to buy bread before the next gate closes.
A glint in the dust turns out to be a coin missed by every cartwheel before you.
A wounded traveler is helped to safer ground, leaving behind a grateful name and a debt that may matter later.

onSuccess.text: A crude toll rope snaps up across the road, but quick feet carry you around the trap before the collectors can close in.

onFail.text: A crude toll rope snaps up across the road, and the collectors vanish only after taking a hard payment.

onSuccess.text: A hand brushes too close to your purse, and a sharp glance sends the cutpurse melting back into the crowd.

onFail.text: The road crowd closes and opens again; only afterward does the lighter purse tell the story.

onSuccess.text: Pebbles tick down the slope, and a fast scramble gets everyone clear before the larger stones follow.

onFail.text: A scatter of falling stones forces a bruising detour over broken ground.

effects.text: A masked bandit steps from cover with steel already drawn.
Lean shapes pace the roadside brush, then one hungry wolf breaks into a charge.

onSuccess.text: A tense exchange at the roadside ends with the bandits deciding easier prey must be somewhere else.

onFail.text: The roadside argument curdles into violence.

onSuccess.text: A stretch of track has slumped into mud, but you pick a dry line across and lose no time.

onFail.text: The track has washed out, and the long slog around it leaves you soaked and spent.

onSuccess.text: A self-appointed road-warden demands a passage fee; a few flat words and a steady stare send him looking for easier coin.

onFail.text: A self-appointed road-warden demands a passage fee, and it is cheaper to pay than to argue with the cudgel behind him.

effects.text: A wayshrine waits under a bent tree. A small offering leaves the road feeling kinder underfoot.
A loose stone hides a small traveler's cache, forgotten long enough that no owner is coming back for it.

onSuccess.text: A strange notch in an old marker reveals a hidden cache tucked behind the stone.

onFail.text: The old marker looks meaningful for a moment, but whatever secret it held stays sealed.

effects.text: Rival adventurers trade a useful shortcut for a story from the road, and leave behind a share of their find.
An old hermit marks the dust with a blessing and sends you onward with lighter steps.

onSuccess.text: A cold campsite left in a hurry still hides good gear for anyone who reads the signs — you leave richer than you came.

onFail.text: A cold campsite offers nothing but ash and the sense that its owners left in a hurry.

effects.text: A carter with a shed wheel is glad of a hand, and pays the favor forward with coin and a bag of road-bread.
